description: This file serves as a client-side API module for communicating with a backend server in a React application. It provides functions to obtain the base URL, handle authentication headers, perform JSON requests, and expose specific API methods such as user search, registration, login, and administrative data retrieval. It emphasizes security by not calling GitHub directly from frontend and managing tokens securely on the backend.

methods.name: getBaseUrl()
methods.description: Determines and returns the normalized API base URL, considering environment variables and security constraints.

methods.name: authHeaders()
methods.description: Returns authorization headers containing the Bearer token if available.

methods.name: requestJson(url, { method, headers, body, op })
methods.description: Performs a fetch request expecting JSON, with detailed error handling and diagnostics for network and HTTP errors.

methods.name: searchUser(username)
methods.description: Searches for a GitHub user via the backend API. Handles response parsing and errors.

methods.name: register(email, password)
methods.description: Registers a new user and retrieves a JWT token.

methods.name: login(email, password)
methods.description: Logs in a user with email and password, returning a JWT token.

methods.name: getAdminHistory()
methods.description: Fetches recent search history for the admin panel, protected endpoint.

methods.name: getAdminStats()
methods.description: Fetches admin statistics data, protected endpoint.

ctags.name: requestJson
ctags.pattern: /^async function requestJson(url, { method, headers, body, op }) {$/
